mapper.select: /** * selectUserInfo : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TlcmtChgReqstdMapper : 기본정보 조회 */ SELECT T1.USER_ID AS USER_ID /* 상담원 아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T2.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM /* 상담원 이름 */ , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS WRT_YMD /* 현재 일자 */ , T3.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM /* 부서명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T2.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 휴대전화번호 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SAB881 T4 /* 첨부파일상세 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T4.ATFINO = T2.ATFINO AND T4.FILE_STTS_SE_CD = 'N' AND T4.ATCMFL_CL_NM = '서명사진' ) AS ATCMFL_CNT /* 첨부파일 카운트 */ , T2.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , '서명사진' AS ATCMFL_CL_NM /* 첨부파일분류명 */ FROM SAA200 T1 /* 사용자 테이블 */ , SCA100 T2 /* 종사자 테이블 */ , SAA300 T3 /* 기관부서 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T3.DEPT_CD = T2.OGDP_DEPT_CD AND T1.ENFSN_NO = T2.ENFSN_NO AND T1.USER_ID = #{loginId}

/** * selectTlcmtChgReqstdList : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TlcmtChgReqstdMapper : 재택근무지변경신청 목록조회 */ SELECT AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , AA.CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM , AA.HMTRC_WORK_CHG_YMD AS HMTRC_WORK_CHG_YMD , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT,'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_YMD , AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD , CC.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT FROM AYC340 AA /** 재택근무지 변경 **/ , SAA200 BB , SCA100 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID = #{loginId} AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID = BB.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO ORDER BY AA.FRST_REG_DT DESC
mapper.update: /** * deleteTlcmtChgReqstd : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TlcmtChgReqstdMapper : 재택근무지변경신청 삭제 */ UPDATE AYC340 AA /** 재택근무지 변경 **/ SET AA.DEL_YN = 'Y' , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{indexSn}
